permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talks only to your own TapDesk server: public market prices, your watched TON wallet (read-only) and your paper trades.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Listens only while you hold to talk, for a voice command. The audio goes only to your own TapDesk server for transcription.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Used for voice commands only when the glasses microphone is not available. The audio goes only to your own TapDesk server.
